name: Watashi no Real wa Juujitsu Shisugiteiru
original_name: 私のリアルは充実しすぎている
source:
Anesaki Nozomi is a closet otaku. Despite acting like a model student at school (even being the vice president of the student council), at home she mostly plays otome games. The only one who knows the truth about herself is her step-brother Shun, whom she is currently living alone with because their parents are overseas.

[Edited from [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2014/04/04/otome-game-review-watashi-no-real-wa-jujitsu-shisugiteiru]Hinano's post[/url]]
translation:
姉崎希美是一名隐藏身份的御宅族。虽然在学校里表现得像个模范生，甚至担任学生会副会长，她在家却大多时候都在玩乙女游戏。唯一知道她真实一面的，是继弟隼。由于父母去了海外，目前两人独自在家生活。

［编译自[url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2014/04/04/otome-game-review-watashi-no-real-wa-jujitsu-shisugiteiru]Hinano的文章[/url]］
